inputs.bars_caveat: the bar panel is survivor-selected (CLAUDE.md 2026-09-22); a dead name's claim is UNGRADEABLE, and control cells exclude names with no exit bar

pit_rules.known_from: first session that OPENS after publication (ET; before 09:30 on a session day = that session); date-only stamps -> the NEXT session
pit_rules.matched_control: equal-weight mean of every other name in the unit's matched_twins cell (size band x vol_63 tercile x mom_252_21 tercile) as of the close before entry; fallback band_vol -> band -> any (control_level on each row)
pit_rules.mw_consensus_dated_by: first_seen_utc (when Aegis saw the page), so today's pages are OPEN
pit_rules.archive_articles: graded from their publication time: a historical evaluation, not a forward forecast; the LLM that extracted the claim read it after the fact (lookahead-propensity owed, CLAUDE.md S53)

closed_not_rederived.first_mover_raises: -0.06% at 21d PIT (t -0.26); the +1.34% version was look-ahead
closed_not_rederived.skill_mom: analyst-skill filter edge is 2025 only (-18.1 pp ex-2025)

verdict_rules.ALPHA_DETECTED: clustered t vs matched control >= 2.0 AND net of the source's common drift >= 2.0, leave-one-month-out worst > 0, top-5 share < 1
verdict_rules.BETA_EXPLAINS: t vs SPY >= 2.0 but vs matched control < 2.0; OR t vs control >= 2.0 but net of the source's common drift < 2.0
verdict_rules.neutral_stance: hit = |excess vs SPY| < 1 sigma*sqrt(h); ALPHA_DETECTED only if the Wilson lower bound > 0.6827
